title: Add-on Therapy for Type 2 Diabetes Inadequately Controlled on Metformin
brief_summary: Tests whether an oral add-on drug lowers HbA1c in adults with type 2 diabetes on stable metformin.
inclusion: Adults aged 18 to 75 years
Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes for at least 6 months
HbA1c between 7.5% and 10.5%
Stable metformin dose of at least 1000 mg/day for 8 weeks
exclusion: History of heart failure (NYHA class III or IV)

title: Basal Insulin Titration Study in Type 2 Diabetes
brief_summary: Compares two titration algorithms in insulin-treated adults with type 2 diabetes.
inclusion: Type 2 diabetes treated with basal insulin for at least 3 months
HbA1c 7% to 11%

title: Closed-Loop Insulin Delivery in Type 1 Diabetes
brief_summary: Evaluates a hybrid closed-loop system in people with type 1 diabetes.
inclusion: Clinical diagnosis of type 1 diabetes for at least 1 year
Using insulin pump therapy

title: Anti-IL-5 Biologic for Severe Eosinophilic Asthma
brief_summary: Tests a biologic in severe eosinophilic asthma uncontrolled on high-dose inhaled corticosteroids.
inclusion: Age 18 to 70 years
Severe asthma on high-dose inhaled corticosteroid plus a second controller
At least 2 exacerbations in the past 12 months
Blood eosinophils of at least 300 cells/uL
exclusion: Current smoker or smoking history of 10 pack-years or more

title: Bronchial Thermoplasty Registry in Adults With Asthma
brief_summary: Observational registry of adults with severe asthma undergoing bronchial thermoplasty.
inclusion: Severe persistent asthma in adults
Scheduled for bronchial thermoplasty

title: Inhaler Technique Education for Children With Asthma
brief_summary: School-based inhaler technique program for children aged 6 to 11 with asthma.
inclusion: Children aged 6 to 11 years
Physician-diagnosed asthma

title: Pulmonary Rehabilitation in COPD
brief_summary: Compares home-based and center-based pulmonary rehabilitation in COPD.
inclusion: Diagnosis of COPD with FEV1/FVC below 0.70
Smoking history of at least 10 pack-years

title: SGLT2 Inhibitor in Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction
brief_summary: Evaluates an SGLT2 inhibitor in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, with or without diabetes.
inclusion: Symptomatic heart failure (NYHA class II to IV)
Left ventricular ejection fraction above 40%

title: Neoadjuvant Therapy for HER2-Positive Breast Cancer
brief_summary: Tests a neoadjuvant regimen in early HER2-positive breast cancer.
inclusion: Histologically confirmed HER2-positive invasive breast cancer
Stage II or III disease

title: Preventive Treatment for Chronic Migraine
brief_summary: Evaluates a CGRP antagonist for preventing chronic migraine.
inclusion: History of chronic migraine for at least 1 year
15 or more headache days per month
